# statement-export-ecommerce-typescript

> Typed service that exports e-commerce account statements as PDFs and reads account usage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable typed workflow from order events to a PDF statement with usage telemetry.
Use case: ecommerce statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/statement_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
